newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Maseca raised, Gruma started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Maseca raised, Gruma started.

text.p: Caspian said on Thursday it raised its recommendation of Maseca to buy from market performer and initiated coverage of Gruma with a market performer rating.

"The government's latest decree regarding corn flour subsidies will allow for a resumption in earnings growth from 1998," analysts Damian Fraser and Jorge Sanchez said in a report about Maseca. They said Gruma also faces strong growth prospects.

"While margins will improve at Gruma Corp. in the United States and at Gruma Central America, the company is planning to enter new markets (such as bread in Mexico) which could become a cash drain if competition proves tough," the analysts wrote.

They added that Maseca's future is more certain because flour and tortilla consumption is stable and less sensitive to economic conditions. Gruma, on the other hand, is venturing into the less certain bread sector, Fraser and Sanchez said.
Caspian estimated Maseca's 1997 earnings per share at 0.63 pesos, and 1.83 pesos per share for Gruma.
Maseca's shares in Mexico stood at 9.44 pesos each, up 10 centavos from Wednesday's closing price. Gruma shares were unchanged in early trading at 40.80 pesos each.
